title: Two cars on a straight road
body: Two cars, P and Q, start together from the same point on a long straight road and their positions are noted every minute for 5 minutes. Positions of car P (in km) at 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 min: 0, 1.2, 2.4, 3.6, 4.8 and 6.0. Positions of car Q (in km) at the same times: 0, 0.8, 2.0, 3.0, 4.6 and 6.0. A student wants to find out which car, if any, moved in uniform linear motion, and to compare the average speeds of the two cars over the full 5 minutes.
